author: Al Jazeera English
description:
Diplomatic efforts to end the war between the United States and Iran are continuing, with both sides signalling a willingness to negotiate while maintaining military readiness.

Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf says Tehran has delivered a strong response to Washington and that the next move rests with the United States. President Donald Trump says Iran wants a settlement, while US Vice President JD Vance says the administration sees progress towards a possible negotiated agreement.

But major differences remain. Washington wants verifiable guarantees that Iran will not rebuild its nuclear programme, while Tehran is seeking action on economic restrictions and the US blockade of Iranian ports. China is also becoming more involved in diplomatic efforts.

Zun Alinani, founding director of the Arab Perspectives Institute, joins Al Jazeera live from Doha to discuss the negotiations, the obstacles to an agreement and the risk of renewed escalation.

title: US-Iran war: Diplomatic efforts continue as both sides maintain military readiness

author: Al Jazeera English
description:
At least 26 people have been killed and five injured in Russian air strikes on Ukraine's southern Zaporizhzhia region. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Russian forces dropped aerial bombs on a school being used to distribute humanitarian aid, before launching nine more bombs at a shelter where people had gathered. He has accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians and called for a strong international response. The attack struck the village of Komyshuvakha, where nearly 30 people are also reported missing. Rescue workers and a police officer were among those killed when another glide bomb hit the area during rescue operations. The village is around 10 kilometres from Russian positions and lies within what Ukrainian forces describe as a frontline drone “kill zone”. The increasing use of drones has made it dangerous for civilians, particularly elderly and less mobile residents, to remain in settlements close to the front line.

title: Russian air strikes kill at least 26 in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region
